caption: The drawing depicts a hand drill set against a plain beige background. The tool has a U-shaped wooden frame with a round, knob-like handle on the left end, colored in light to medium brown tones suggesting wood grain. At the right end, the frame supports a horizontal spindle that extends forward and ends with a dark-colored, spiral-shaped metal drill bit. The spindle has a transition from a wood section to a metal section where the drill bit begins. The composition is centered, with the hand drill placed horizontally in the middle of the image. Below the frame of the drill, slightly to the right, the name "Violet Hartenstein" is written in small, neat handwriting.
title: Brace and Bit
